summary.implementedScope: Implemented the Epic 6 Story 0 foundation by expanding shared source attachment vocabulary, adding source-management route contracts/schemas, introducing durable source provenance schema seams in Convex, and updating fixtures/tests to require the new repository identity and freshness fields.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead scoped acceptance is ready for impl-lead review and outer acceptance.

changedFiles.reason: Expanded shared source enums, error codes, and source attachment summary schema with provider, canonical repo identity, freshness snapshot fields, refresh metadata, and detach metadata.
Added shared source-management route constants plus request/response/provenance schemas for later Epic 6 stories.
Re-exported the new source-management shared contracts module.
Added Fastify route schema definitions for attach, update, refresh, detach, and provenance endpoints.
Added server-side constants for the new source-management error codes.
Extended the durable source attachment table fields and summary projection to include canonical identity, freshness snapshots, refresh state, and soft-detach fields.
Added the new durable source provenance table field definition for Epic 6.
Registered the expanded source attachment indexes and new source provenance table/indexes in the Convex schema.
Expanded source fixtures to the new contract shape and added pending refresh, detached, shadowing, duplicate-target-ref, and provenance fixtures/helpers.
Updated Convex summary projection coverage for provider, repositoryFullName, freshness snapshots, refresh metadata, and detach metadata.
Extended contract validation coverage so source schemas reject missing required Epic 6 identity and freshness fields.
Added Story 0 contract tests for source-management requests/responses, source-management error codes, shadowing fixtures, and degraded provenance fixtures.
Updated integration source seeds to satisfy the expanded source attachment summary contract.
Updated service test source seeds to satisfy the expanded source attachment summary contract.
Updated API test source seeds to satisfy the expanded source attachment summary contract and stale/not-hydrated fixture semantics.
Updated process API test source seeds to satisfy the expanded source attachment summary contract.
